awarding_entity: Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Company Limited
significant_terms: Design, Manufacture, Supply, Transport, Installation, Testing and Commissioning of 2000 Off-Grid DC Solar Photovoltaic Water Pumping Systems ('SPWPS') of 3HP, 5 HP & 7.5 HP capacity at identified farmer's site in Districts of Maharashtra, including complete system warranty and its repair and maintenance and Remote Monitoring System ('RMS') for 5 years under PM Kusum B Scheme "Magel Tyala Saur Krushi Pump" Yojana.
execution_period_raw: The Installation is be completed within 60 days from the date of issuance of NTP/ Work Order/ JSR approval.
labeller_notes: Press release lists 'Nature of order: Domestic' (a domestic/international answer), so nature_of_order left null. execution_months = 60 days converted to months. Press release calls it the company's largest single solar EPC order to date.
